title: Pair pack (pair.json) v1
$comment: UniversalCorePlan.md §3.1/§6/§12 UC-12: pair.json is course-pack-v1.schema.json's fields minus lang/<code>/lexicon.json's (nouns/adjectives/verbs/personalPronouns/possessives/morphology/stemAlternations) — the pl-ru pair's own copy, skills content, reference/training screens and vocabulary. This schema checks the layer's own shape; scripts/validate-pack-v2.mjs additionally reconstructs the full v1 pack (lexicon + pair) and revalidates it against course-pack-v1.schema.json plus validateCoursePack's existing invariants, so nothing here duplicates or drifts from that stricter, already-tested check.
